before.policy: Minimum-image periodic distances. All NonbondedForce exception pairs (including bonded 1-2/1-3/1-4 pairs) excluded from severe-contact counts; thresholds are hard-overlap diagnostics, not all steric clashes.

after.policy: Minimum-image periodic distances. All NonbondedForce exception pairs (including bonded 1-2/1-3/1-4 pairs) excluded from severe-contact counts; thresholds are hard-overlap diagnostics, not all steric clashes.

convergence: Not certified; iteration-limited minimization with constraint repair. Gradient includes internal constraint penalty and is not an independent physical-force convergence test.
limitations: Observed six-chain core, not full-length fibrinogen; glycans and long unresolved tails omitted
Finite oligomer PE patch, not validated bulk crystal
Soft restraints on protein heavy atoms and all PE carbons; water/H/Ca/Na mobile subject to bond constraints
Fixed box; minimization cannot establish liquid density, temperature, pressure or interface equilibrium
No adsorption, binding/free energy, PTFE or PVDF result
